# Site-integration addendum for agentic game-build prompts

Paste this into the initial prompt when having a model build a new game for
`projects/games/<slug>/index.html`. It exists so the output is CI-ready and
nav-safe without a manual integration pass afterward.

---

This game will be embedded in a larger site with a shared top nav bar. Follow
these constraints exactly:

1. `<body class="nav-autohide">` — the body tag must carry this class.

2. Immediately after `<body ...>`, paste this nav snippet byte-for-byte,
   unmodified (it will be provided to you as `_includes/nav-inject.html` —
   copy it verbatim, including the `<!-- bl-nav:canonical -->` marker at the
   top).

3. Do not restyle, override, or remove anything with id `bl-nav`,
   `bl-nav-toggle`, `bl-nav-links`, `bl-nav-fab`, or class `bl-nav__*`.

4. If your `<body>` CSS uses `display: flex` (e.g. to center the game
   canvas), do **not** apply that centering to `body` directly — wrap the
   game's own content in an inner container (e.g. `<div class="game-root">`)
   and apply the flex centering to that container instead. `body`'s only
   children should be the pasted nav snippet and your game-root container.
   (Centering flex rules on `body` will visually crush the nav bar into the
   middle of the screen — this is a known failure mode, avoid it.)

5. Reserve the top-right corner of the viewport for the site nav's menu
   button. Do not place your own pause/menu/settings button there. Use
   top-left, or bottom-center, instead.

6. If you add a `Content-Security-Policy` meta tag, `style-src` and
   `script-src` must both include `'unsafe-inline'` (all game code and
   styles are inline in a single file) — omitting it will silently break the
   nav bar's styling with no visible error.

7. Add this metadata comment inside `<head>`, right after the CSP meta tag:

   ```html
   <!-- bl-game-meta
   title: <Display Name>
   emoji: <single emoji>
   order: 999
   description: <one line, end with "Made by <model> in <tool> on <hardware>." if built agentically>
   -->
   ```

   Leave `order: 999` — the site owner will assign the real sort position
   when integrating the game; don't guess it.

8. Do not hand-edit `projects/games/index.html` (the games listing) — it is
   auto-generated by `.github/scripts/build_games_registry.py` from the
   metadata comment above. Adding your game's directory with the metadata
   block is sufficient; a GitHub Actions workflow regenerates the listing
   and deploys automatically.
